name: listId
label: List ID
help: ID of the list to rename, for example 7420000000000000001. Find it in the Retrieve Lists output or at the end of the list's URL.

name: name
label: Name
help: New list name, up to 75 characters on one line. Spaces at the start and end are removed. If another list of this type already has exactly this name, the module fails.
